summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of CRM Multi-tenant Phase 0 - Foundation. Tested login and registration pages with full Spanish interface, Zod validations, navigation, and corporate blue color scheme. All core functionality working as expected for Phase 0.

design_issues.issue: Automatic slug generation is not updating properly when agency name changes

passed_tests: Interface completely in Spanish (all labels, placeholders, error messages)
Form fields have correct data-testids for testing
Navigation between login and registration works correctly
Login form Zod validations working: email validation, password length validation
Registration form Zod validations working: all field validations, password confirmation mismatch
Forgot password link present in Spanish
Footer links in Spanish (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy)
Form fields have appropriate Spanish placeholders
All required registration fields present: agency name, slug, full name, email, password, confirm password
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix automatic slug generation feature in registration form - the slug should update dynamically when agency name changes
